sections.Profile:
The "Hot Race" pinball machine, produced by Italian manufacturer A.M.I. in 1976, features an auto racing theme. This electro-mechanical game includes two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, and a four-bank of drop targets.

- Manufacturer: A.M.I.
- Years made: 1975
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Racing, Sports, Original Theme, 1970s, Cars, Single level playfield
